question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "**silence**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank 1 will imply how the silence was broken by the loud crack.
 
• Also, **the adjective "sleepy" implies the quiet state of the place.**
 
• **Thus, among the given options, the correct word to fill blank 1 is "silence."**
 
 
• "Silence" means a place with no noise or sound at all.(शांति)
 
• Example: The sudden silence in the room made everyone uneasy.
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits the context of the sentence.

​Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "blast" means a sudden loud noise or explosion. It is not appropriate in the given context.(धमाका)
 
• Option 2: "lull" means a period of calm or quiet. It is not appropriate in the given context.(शांति काल)
 
• Option 3: "blackout" means a sudden loss of electricity or consciousness. It is not appropriate in the given context.(अंधकार)
